overview: Use a versioned unread-count snapshot and ID-based notification deduplication. Optimistic read state is a reversible overlay until acknowledgement. After connection gaps refetch count and page before accepting later events. The graph separates browser interaction state, server query state and the existing backend. It is one defensible approach; equivalent boundaries and well-argued alternatives are welcome.
limitations: Design checks inspect structure and written evidence only; they do not execute a UI or prove accessibility/performance.

estimation.calculation: Set membership yields 1 row; count does not change 50 times
estimation.result: Identity and versioning matter more than transport speed

components.purpose: Use a versioned unread-count snapshot and ID-based notification deduplication. Optimistic read state is a reversible overlay until acknowledgement. After connection gaps refetch count and page before accepting later events. Performance plan: 100 notifications per retained page window; bursty live events; coalesce badge updates without blocking drawer controls. Accessibility: Use a labelled drawer/dialog with appropriate focus management and Escape behavior; return focus to bell on close. Announce a concise count change, not every historical row. Failure recovery: Read mutation is idempotent; accept only current count versions and refresh authoritative state after a gap. Broadcast invalidation across tabs if supported. Trade-off: Periodic polling may be sufficient. SSE fits server-to-client deltas; WebSocket is useful only when bidirectional traffic is needed.

steps.title: Receive user intent
steps.explanation: Fetch unread count and paginated history. Use a labelled drawer/dialog with appropriate focus management and Escape behavior; return focus to bell on close. Announce a concise count change, not every historical row.

steps.title: Apply the owning transition

steps.title: Render controlled child state
steps.explanation: 100 notifications per retained page window; bursty live events; coalesce badge updates without blocking drawer controls. Child events return to the owner; focus and selection use stable identities.

steps.title: Call or subscribe to the feature dependency
steps.explanation: Live updates supplement a paginated fetch; the stream is not the sole source of notification history. Read mutation is idempotent; accept only current count versions and refresh authoritative state after a gap. Broadcast invalidation across tabs if supported.

steps.title: Resume the remote event channel
steps.explanation: Jittered reconnect, cursor resume when supported; refetch after expired cursor Dedup eventId and notificationId; apply countVersion monotonically

steps.title: Capture user intent without duplicating authority
steps.explanation: Validate local input and enter a pending state. Use the component callback rather than mutating server snapshots directly.

steps.title: Send the versioned operation
steps.explanation: Call PUT /notifications/{id}/read through the API adapter. Request: {read:true,mutationId:"r1"}. A prior successful response or unresolved operation must not be overwritten by a stale retry.

steps.title: Reconcile or expose recovery
steps.explanation: Read mutation is idempotent; accept only current count versions and refresh authoritative state after a gap. Broadcast invalidation across tabs if supported. Update the query key with the acknowledged version or invalidate/refetch it; maintain focus and make pending/error state visible.

failureCases.scenario: Two tabs read the same notification during a reconnect
failureCases.handling: Read mutation is idempotent; accept only current count versions and refresh authoritative state after a gap. Broadcast invalidation across tabs if supported.

failureCases.scenario: Route or identity changes while work is in flight
failureCases.handling: Dispose subscriptions, abort obsolete reads and ignore old generations; partition/clear private cache before showing a new account. Preserve only explicitly safe drafts.
